De libro Apocalýpsis beáti Joánnis Apóstoli
<r>Apo 11:19; 12:1-2</r>
<n>19</n> Et apértum est templum Dei in cælo: et visa est arca testaménti ejus in templo ejus, et facta sunt fúlgura, et voces, et terræmótus, et grando magna.
<n>1</n> Et signum magnum appáruit in cælo: múlier amícta sole, et luna sub pédibus ejus, et in cápite ejus coróna stellárum duódecim:
<n>2</n> Et in útero habens, clamábat partúriens, et cruciabátur ut páriat.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℣.</r> Et sústulit me in spíritu in montem magnum et altum.
<r>℟.</r> Et vidi Jerúsalem descendéntem de cælo, ornátam monílibus suis, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

b.054c26a5d8:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
<r>℟.</r> Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>D</c>eus, qui in Fílii tui humilitáte jacéntem mundum erexísti: fidélibus tuis perpétuam concéde lætítiam; ut, quos perpétuæ mortis eripuísti cásibus, gáudiis fácias pérfrui sempitérnis.
<h>P</h>er eúndem Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.dbfe1205fe:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> O Lord, hear my prayer.
<r>℟.</r> And let my cry come unto thee.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>O</c> God, Whose Son hath humbled Himself, and Who hast through Him raised up the whole world, grant to thy faithful people everlasting joy; and as Thou hast delivered them from the bitter pains of eternal death, make them to be glad for ever in thy presence.
<h>T</h>hrough the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>Q</c>uintodécimo Kaléndas Maii Luna undécima. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>R</h>omæ sancti Anicéti, Papæ et Mártyris; qui martýrii palmam in persecutióne Marci Aurélii Antoníni et Lúcii Veri accépit.
<h>C</h>órdubæ, in Hispánia, sanctórum Mártyrum Eliæ Presbýteri, Pauli et Isidóri Monachórum, qui, in persecutióne Arábica, ob Christiánæ fídei professiónem, interémpti sunt.
<h>A</h>ntiochíæ sanctórum Mártyrum Petri Diáconi, et Hermógenis, qui ejúsdem Petri erat miníster.
<h>I</h>n Africa natális beáti Mappálici Mártyris, qui (ut scribit sanctus Cypriánus in epístola ad Mártyres et Confessóres), cum áliis plúribus, martýrio coronátus est.
<h>I</h>bídem sanctórum Mártyrum Fortunáti et Marciáni.
<h>V</h>iénnæ, in Gállia, sancti Pantágathi Epíscopi.
<h>D</h>ertónæ sancti Innocéntii, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
<h>C</h>istércii, in Gállia, sancti Stéphani Abbátis, qui primus erémum Cisterciénsem incóluit, et sanctum Bernárdum, cum sóciis ad se veniéntem, lætus excépit.
<h>I</h>n monastério Casæ Dei, Claromontánæ diœcésis, in Gállia, sancti Robérti Confessóris, qui ejúsdem monastérii cónditor et primus Abbas éxstitit.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.b4182208a2:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>A</c>pril 17th 2027, the 11th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>A</h>t Rome, the holy martyr Pope Anicetus, [in the year 175,] who received the palm of martyrdom in the persecution under Marcus Aurelius Antoninus and Lucius Verus.
<h>A</h>t Cordova, the holy martyrs Elias the Priest, and the monks Paul and Isidore, [in the year 856.]
<h>A</h>t Antioch, the holy martyrs Peter the Deacon and Hermogenes his servant.
<h>I</h>n Africa, the blessed martyr Mappalicus, who, [in the year 250,] was crowned, along with diverse other martyrs, as it is written by holy Cyprian in his epistle to the Martyrs and Confessors.
<h>L</h>ikewise in Africa, the holy martyrs Fortunatus and Marcian.
<h>A</h>t Vienne, [in the year 540,] holy Pantagathus, Bishop [of that see. He sat for five years and is reckoned the twentieth Bishop of the see. He was present at the Third Council of Orleans. He had been consul.]
<h>A</h>t Tortona, the holy Confessor Innocent, Bishop [of that see, in the year 351.]
<h>I</h>n the monastery of Chaise-Dieu, in the Diocese of Clermont, the holy Confessor Robert, the founder and first Abbot of that monastery, [in the year 1067.]
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

b.9c311374c3:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dóminus vobíscum.
<r>℟.</r> Et cum spíritu tuo.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>D</c>eus, qui in Fílii tui humilitáte jacéntem mundum erexísti: fidélibus tuis perpétuam concéde lætítiam; ut, quos perpétuæ mortis eripuísti cásibus, gáudiis fácias pérfrui sempitérnis.
<h>P</h>er eúndem Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.467f7da150:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>O</c> God, Whose Son hath humbled Himself, and Who hast through Him raised up the whole world, grant to thy faithful people everlasting joy; and as Thou hast delivered them from the bitter pains of eternal death, make them to be glad for ever in thy presence.
<h>T</h>hrough the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
